summary: Prevent false connected readings from DISCONNECTED text, report uncertain checks as DEGRADED, and expose live score-feed state while marking unreported freshness explicitly.

scoped_evidence.affected_subsystem: HBNF Cart Owner PWA readiness preflight, live-feed state, and offline/package delivery of imported pure readiness and live-display helpers.
scoped_evidence.observed_source_defect: The previous /CONNECTED|READY/i/ expression matched the CONNECTED substring in DISCONNECTED. The preflight header treated only FAIL as a hard failure and printed READY/CHECK when WAN or device truth was uncertain. The live_status response does not expose a source update timestamp, so freshness is now disclosed as unavailable and cannot silently appear fully READY.
scoped_evidence.rollback_reference: Revert this isolated source commit; no runtime or production mutation is part of this change.
